name: Summary estimate calculation, twelve chapters
review_status: The twelve chapters are the ones the platform already seeds as its cost breakdown dimension; this document states them rather than introducing them. The chapter titles are drawn from public sources and are pending review by a Russian cost engineer.
description: A construction project's cost is presented as one document with twelve chapters in a fixed order, and the order is not a convention that a client may vary. Object estimates aggregate into chapter 2 and the chapters aggregate into the summary, so a cost that has no chapter to belong to is a cost that has not been thought about: temporary works, developer supervision and design fees each have their own chapter precisely so that nobody buries them in the building.
